displayDescription: Gouache dusk valley: an ochre idea ring is brushed in, hills repaint in dry-brush sweeps, and light links four houses.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (native browser API): cached gouache paint layers, seeded directional bristle dabs, coverage-mask compositing via destination-in
HTML/CSS lettering in system Gill Sans / Avenir Next
motionEngine: GSAP (local gsap.min.js) single paused timeline at window.__timelines.video; a function-based clock tween redraws the canvas from composition time; GSAP tweens own headline clip-path and subtitle opacity/y
audioDescription: Silent preview; no audio track. Authored visual cue sequence: ring stroke 0.15s, hill sweeps 0.25s/0.5s, beam 1.15s, houses 1.0-1.75s, window lights 1.68/2.02/2.15/2.32s, settled by 2.6s.
limitations: Gouache is approximated procedurally in Canvas 2D with opaque seeded bristle dabs and a stationary grain overlay; there is no physical pigment, paper absorption or brush simulation.
Window glow and the idea-ring halo use translucent dab clusters as a lighting approximation, not real light transport.

Dusk palette is scene-dependent, following the background review lesson (dominant cool field, one warm complementary accent family for focal light). The cream swatch is reused only for lettering and house walls; it is not the canvas colour.

The source reference (a framed oil night scene that becomes an interactive 3D walk-through) informed only stroke direction, the cool field with warm light accents, and the dark anchoring forms. Its subject, frame, interface and wording were not copied, and its 3D push-in was not used in this 2D scene.
STYLE.json lists no preview recipes (tech.preview_recipes absent/empty), so the preview demonstrates the base implementation: medium-specific paint layers with coverage-mask brush reveals.
Blender was not used, per user instruction. No render or browser test was run by the agent.

Typography uses the OS-bundled Gill Sans via @font-face src: local() declarations (no font file shipped). Where Gill Sans is not installed, the stack falls back to Avenir Next, Futura, Helvetica Neue or Arial.
